repo_meta_data.description: The verification layer for autonomous agents — an independent, capital-aware verdict before an irreversible action (/review), a cryptographically signed proof after, and a public on-chain track record, losses included. Free EdgeProof backtest validation. Underneath: memory, sandboxed execution, marketplace. Pay in sats, USDC (x402), or card.
